verdict.rationale: Unity's AI Assistant is documented to let users "create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance, and perform project actions using natural-language prompts," and this is bridged to LLM agents via an official MCP server, directly satisfying the natural-language operation story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of natural-language command reliability/quality, and clarity on how the newer CLI's non-MCP 'unity eval' mode complements vs replaces the natural-language flow.
